title: Late Summer Citrus Breeze

diffuser.notes: Perfect for a light, uplifting afternoon pick-me-up.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist lightly in the room.

why_it_works: Sweet orange brings a cheerful, sunny lift; lavender softens the heat with calm; peppermint adds a cool, refreshing edge—ideal for late summer humidity.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
